Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.

results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. [...] State-by-state data shows Trump underwater in every swing state, meaning even small shifts in voter sentiment could help determine control of Congress in November.
